guideline: Use background: true to return a Shell Job after startup, and pty: true only when it needs a terminal. Use read on the Job's log path, job_stop to stop it, and job_send or job_key for PTY input. Completion is delivered automatically; continue independent work or conclude your turn.
stop: Stop a Shell Job owned by this Agent.
send: Send literal text to a running PTY Job. Set enter to send Enter after the text; defaults to false.
key: Send one terminal key to a running PTY Job, for example Enter or C-c.
